text:
Ravi (PM): quick regroup — two competing Q2 asks: 1) embedding regression patch impacting GammaTech & DeltaApps, 2) enterprise partition (reserved throughput slice) that Sales says will close multiple deals. need a concise RICE-style call.
Maya (Eng Lead): patch looks smallish but hot. partition is large infra + PLUMBING.
Tess (Design): partition needs a small admin UI and some UX flows for quotas. could we scope an MVP?
Omar (Data): numbers: GammaTech+DeltaApps ~12% of ARR; regression raises error rate ~4% for them.
Noah (Sales): partition pipeline = 7 active deals, est $1.1M ARR if demos by EOM. customers pushing.
Ravi (PM): proposal: do a fast patch + do a 3-week spike for partition MVP. then rescore. thoughts?
Maya (Eng Lead): concern: patch might require immediate infra downtime window unless we feature-flag. rollbacks matter.
Tess (Design): I can deliver an MVP wireframe in 6 days if we freeze scope.
Omar (Data): eyeballing RICE:
```
reach: patch = 0.12, partition MVP = 0.28
impact: patch = 6/10 (retains customers), partition = 9/10 (new revenue)
confidence: patch = 80%, partition = 45%
effort: patch = 2 eng-days, partition MVP spike = 6 eng-weeks
score = (reach * impact * confidence) / effort
```
Maya (Eng Lead): with that math patch wins for immediate work. partition still high strategic value.
Noah (Sales): agree patch first. but we need to lock a sales demo slot — can the spike produce a non-prod demo?
Ravi (PM): spike goal: confirm capacity isolation + basic admin UI for quotas. demoable to sales at end of spike.
Maya (Eng Lead): plan: create `feature:embed-regression-patch-v2` branch + canary. schedule rolling deploy to staging. ci-bot: schedule set for 2555554360.
ci-bot: deploy job queued by @Maya (Eng Lead) 123456.
Omar (Data): I'll add a canary dashboard and add a confidence delta field in the RICE sheet.
Tess (Design): I'll attach the wireframes to the partition spike ticket.
Noah (Sales): I'll broker a demo window with top pipeline deals and tell them the spike goal.
Ravi (PM): owners: Maya = patch, Tess = partition wires, Omar = metrics, Noah = demos. sync in 48h. :thumbsup:  
Maya (Eng Lead): starting patch branch now, aim to deploy to staging today.
Tess (Design): okay will post wireframes and a trimmed scope doc.
Omar (Data): posting canary link once metrics are live.
Noah (Sales): calling out GammaTech contact to acknowledge fix plan.
Ravi (PM): we'll run a full RICE rescore after the 3-week spike and decide commit vs postpone. thanks everyone.
